[[Axiomatic Burst#Axiomatic Burst|Axiomatic Burst 4]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Axiomatic Burst#Axiomatic Burst|Axiomatic Burst 4]]:''' This weapon is an implement of law, dealing 4d6 Law damage on a successful hit to Chaotic enemies, and 10d6 Law damage on a critical hit to Chaotic enemies. This effect makes the weapon lawfully aligned.
Chaotic characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
